description: Publish explicitly selected candidate pages to the public live AI product demo (turning the demo link on before first publication), or hold pages to remove them from demos. Use only after showing the candidate list from demopage_list_pages or demopage_import_pages and receiving the user's explicit selection of page ids. Browser readiness checks still keep failing pages out.

approve.description: True (default) publishes the selected pages; false holds them out of demos.

ids.description: Page ids from demopage_list_pages or demopage_import_pages explicitly chosen by the user.

name: demopage_approve_pages
title: Publish or hold interactive demo pages
